name: Open stone ring, no roof 014
glow_concept: soft blue soul-light rising from the water below
prompt: a round fieldstone well with thick stone walls and a heavy peaked wooden roof on two stout posts, a chunky windlass, open stone ring, no roof, leaning slightly, roughly six feet tall, human height, self-emissive at night, softly radiating light: soft blue soul-light rising from the water below

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the glowing water inside the well brightens a little and returns. It is lit and clearly visible in every single frame, including the first. Everything else in the picture is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel, unchanged in shape, size, position and colour. No outline anywhere is redrawn. The last frame matches the first frame exactly, so the loop joins.

It is at its brightest in the MIDDLE of the animation and back to exactly its first-frame brightness and colour at the end. It never fades out and is never dimmer at the end than at the start.
